EVAL-F-002-S1.title: Provider Detail Schema and Contract Definition
EVAL-F-002-S1.description: Define strict response schema for provider detail including NPI, name, taxonomy (primary + secondary), license status, practice address, phone, enumeration date, and constructed external links. Ensure compatibility with evaluate_care_facade and tool response contract with deterministic field presence (null-safe).

EVAL-F-002-S2.title: NPI Provider Detail Retrieval and Normalization Logic
EVAL-F-002-S2.description: Implement CMS NPI Registry API integration with parsing and normalization of credentials, taxonomy, license status, and address. Include deterministic handling for missing fields, API timeouts, and empty responses, plus enrichment with state board links and research URLs.

EVAL-F-002-S3.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Provider Detail
EVAL-F-002-S3.description: Integrate provider_detail_service into evaluate_care_facade with consistent orchestration, ensuring output alignment with evaluation workflows and compatibility with downstream quality signal features.

EVAL-F-002-S4.title: Provider Detail API and Tool Router Exposure
EVAL-F-002-S4.description: Expose provider detail lookup via FastAPI endpoint and register with tool_router, including Pydantic input validation (NPI), structured JSON output, and standardized error handling for invalid or unavailable provider records.

EVAL-F-002-S5.title: Provider Detail Unit and End-to-End Integration Tests
EVAL-F-002-S5.description: Implement unit tests for parsing and normalization logic and integration tests covering full flow (API → tool_router → facade → service). Include edge cases: malformed NPI, missing CMS fields, API failure, and empty results.
